elendel.name: Elendel
elendel.desc: Capital of the Basin, split into eight octants by canals around the Field of Rebirth, on Hammondar Bay. The equator runs close by and the prime meridian through it.

e27.title: Shadows of Self
e27.text: A rogue kandra murders her way through the city’s elite, and Harmony’s quiet influence comes into the open.

landmarks.name: The Field of Rebirth
landmarks.desc: The park at the centre of the eight octants, with a museum and tomb. Wax gets in through a secret door in its atium chamber.

landmarks.name: Ladrian mansion
landmarks.desc: The near-bankrupt house Wax inherits when he comes back from the Roughs.

landmarks.name: The governor’s mansion
landmarks.desc: Bleeder breaks into the safe room here, and Wax later works out she has taken the governor’s place.

landmarks.name: Eastbridge
landmarks.desc: On the suspension tower of this bridge Wax corners Bleeder, who wears Lessie’s face.

landmarks.name: The Village
landmarks.desc: The Terris enclave where Wax’s grandmother lived.

landmarks.desc: Raised by the city after The Lost Metal.
